front.title: Anthropic prices IPO at $83 a share, above projected range
front.tldr: The AI company's long-awaited IPO priced above its target range, valuing it at $1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis.

front.title: Nolan and del Toro break down The Odyssey's monsters and AI's limits with VFX supervisor Andrew Jackson
front.tldr: The directors discussed building The Odyssey's Cyclops, Scylla and Circe sequences with VFX supervisor Andrew Jackson, and where AI falls short of practical craft.

front.title: Cadillac confirm Bottas to stay with team for 2027
front.tldr: Valtteri Bottas will continue racing for Cadillac alongside Sergio Perez in 2027, ending weeks of speculation and completing the team's driver line-up for the season.

stories.title: Google DeepMind introduces Gemini 4 Neon
stories.tldr: Google DeepMind's new Gemini 4 Neon model promises frontier-level reasoning for complex, high-frequency workflows at Flash-model speeds, now rolling out for AI Pro subscribers.

stories.title: OpenAI introduces GPT‑6.2 Astra and GPT‑6.2 Sol
stories.tldr: OpenAI introduced GPT‑6.2 Astra, a new frontier model for its hardest projects, alongside GPT‑6.2 Sol, a faster, cheaper model built for everyday work.

stories.title: Advancing chip design with OpenAI models
stories.tldr: OpenAI says its models helped optimise circuits in Jalapeño silicon and improve RISC‑V core designs, an early sign of AI helping develop its own hardware.

stories.title: Research acceleration: the jagged frontier
stories.tldr: OpenAI measured how much coding agents accelerate its own research, finding the gains uneven across tasks, an early signal of how close AI is to improving itself.

stories.title: Snapchat now lets developers build AR Lenses with AI assistants like Claude Code and Cursor
stories.tldr: Snapchat lens creators can now describe the AR lens they want in plain language and have an AI coding assistant such as Claude Code or Cursor build it.

stories.title: Google's AI feature in Search gets its own incognito mode
stories.tldr: Google's AI Mode in Search now offers temporary threads, letting people have conversations without adding them to search history or future recommendations.

stories.title: Sony's updated turntable is an easy entry into the world of vinyl
stories.tldr: Sony's refreshed beginner turntable adds automatic playback, USB connectivity and aptX Adaptive Bluetooth, aimed at newcomers to vinyl.

stories.title: Spend management platform Payhawk announces $280M raise, $2B valuation
stories.tldr: Payhawk, the enterprise expense and procurement platform founded in 2018, raised $280 million at a $2 billion valuation, using AI agents to manage spend.

stories.title: Apple's Fall Creator Studio updates now live
stories.tldr: Apple's fall Creator Studio updates are live, including Final Cut Pro with MotionVFX integration, as announced in October.

stories.title: Visual Intelligence is coming to the iPad's Camera app
stories.tldr: The Siri-powered Visual Intelligence mode Apple added to the iPhone's Camera app with iOS 27 is coming to the iPad's Camera app too.

stories.title: Meet the 2026 App Store Award finalists
stories.tldr: Apple named the finalists for its 2026 App Store Awards, recognising 45 developers worldwide for exceptional apps and games.

stories.title: Instagram now lets you save songs to Apple Music
stories.tldr: Instagram added a feature letting users connect an Apple Music account and save songs they discover on the app straight to a playlist.

stories.title: Pierce Brosnan welcomes Robert Pattinson into the James Bond family
stories.tldr: Former 007 Pierce Brosnan publicly welcomed Robert Pattinson as the new James Bond, calling him magnificent, days after Pattinson's casting was announced.

stories.title: Jason Blum and James Wan discuss why horror is Hollywood's hottest genre
stories.tldr: Blumhouse Atomic's Jason Blum and James Wan discussed horror's record year at the box office and why their film Obsession performed so well.

stories.title: Skydance to combine Warner Bros. Television Group and Paramount Television Studios
stories.tldr: Skydance plans to merge Warner Bros. Television Group and Paramount Television Studios into one studio, led jointly by Channing Dungey and Matt Thunell.

stories.title: Elsinore review: Andrew Scott's towering performance can't overcome awards-bait clichés
stories.tldr: IndieWire's review says Andrew Scott is excellent as dying actor Ian Charleson in Elsinore, but the film around him sinks into familiar awards-season cliché.

stories.title: Chris Cenac Jr. flashes promise, growing pains in early minutes
stories.tldr: Rookie Chris Cenac Jr., a raw, athletic prospect not expected to play much this year, has shown flashes in his minutes 14 games into the season.

stories.title: Drake Maye injury update: Patriots teammate drops hint about QB's outlook
stories.tldr: A Patriots teammate's comments suggest quarterback Drake Maye's ankle injury may keep him out for the rest of the season.

stories.title: Piastri to serve grid penalty at Las Vegas GP
stories.tldr: Oscar Piastri will take a 10-place grid penalty at this weekend's Las Vegas Grand Prix after exceeding his season's engine allowance, McLaren confirmed.

stories.title: Fernando Alonso opens up on his daunting Dakar Rally challenge
stories.tldr: Fernando Alonso will contest the 2027 Dakar Rally for Aston Martin before the next Formula 1 season begins, calling it another level of challenge.

stories.title: Red Sox introduce long-coveted free-agent prize Bauers
stories.tldr: The Red Sox formally introduced new signing Jake Bauers, fresh off winning his first Silver Slugger award, at a press conference.

stories.title: Busy Red Sox boost catching depth, acquire Fortes from division rival Rays
stories.tldr: Boston traded for Rays catcher Nick Fortes to boost its catching depth, part of an active start to the offseason.

read.subtitle: A special edition of Lenny's Newsletter

listen.why: Bloomberg built his financial data empire on being first and precise, a fitting listen on a day when an AI company's IPO made market history.
listen.title: #433 How Michael Bloomberg Works

listen.title: Divine Discontent, AI Agents & the Future of Money | Brian Armstrong, Coinbase

finally.title: Hand-marbled papers ground Sylvain Lefebvre's surreal landscapes
finally.tldr: French artist Sylvain Lefebvre grounds his surreal oil landscapes, Journeys Into the Unseen Forest, in hand-marbled paper, balancing chance and control.
